words.example: Overtime pay will accrue if the trial run passes midnight.
words.exampleZh: 試產若過了午夜，加班費就會累積。

words.example: The setup sheet is accurate only after the first article is measured.
words.exampleZh: 首件量完之後，設定表才算準確。

words.example: The automatic feeder jams when the strip is too thin.
words.exampleZh: 料帶太薄時，自動送料機會卡住。

words.example: Automation cut the headcount on packing, not on inspection.
words.exampleZh: 自動化減少的是包裝人力，不是檢驗人力。
words.notes: 用機器取代重複的人工。

words.example: Scan the barcode before the carton leaves the cell.
words.exampleZh: 紙箱離開單元前先掃條碼。

words.example: The technician will blend the two resins before molding.
words.exampleZh: 技術員會在成型前把兩種樹脂混合。
words.notes: 混成一體。也可以指混合物。

words.example: The new coating was a breakthrough for salt-spray life.
words.exampleZh: 新塗層是鹽霧壽命上的突破。
words.notes: 原本做不到、現在做到的進展。

words.example: The first-hour output was breathtaking, and then the feeder jammed.
words.exampleZh: 第一小時的產量驚人，接著送料機就卡住了。

words.example: The first serial number is collectible, so it will not be sold as scrap.
words.exampleZh: 第一個序號值得收藏，所以不會當廢料賣掉。
words.notes: 值得收集。可回收是 recyclable，不是這個字。

words.example: His commitment to the prototype kept the lab open all weekend.
words.exampleZh: 他對原型的投入讓實驗室整個週末都開著。
words.notes: 答應要做，或投入的心力。

words.example: A safety talk raised consciousness of pinch points on the press.
words.exampleZh: 安全講話提高了大家對沖壓機夾點的意識。
words.notes: 知道、覺察。lose consciousness 是失去知覺。

words.example: This cell consistently hits the hourly target.
words.exampleZh: 這個單元一貫達得到每小時目標。
words.notes: 每次都一樣，不忽高忽低。

words.example: Three workshops constitute the new pilot plant.
words.exampleZh: 三個工坊構成新的試量產廠。

words.example: Continuous improvement is written into the weekly huddle.
words.exampleZh: 每週短會都把持續改善寫進去。

words.example: The reserve will cover the loss from the scrapped lot.
words.exampleZh: 準備金會彌補這批報廢的損失。
words.notes: 可以是蓋住，也可以是補上費用。名詞可指封面或蓋子。

words.example: The fixture came from the operator's creativity, not from the design office.
words.exampleZh: 這個治具來自作業員的創造力，不是設計室。

words.example: A cutback in test samples would hide the real defect rate.
words.exampleZh: 削減測試樣品會把真正的不良率藏起來。
words.notes: 把經費、數量或人力減少。

words.example: The developer stayed on the line until the first good part came out.
words.exampleZh: 開發人員一直待在線上，直到做出第一件良品。

words.example: The dynamic balance of the spindle has to be checked again.
words.exampleZh: 主軸的動態平衡必須再測一次。

words.example: Spread the grease evenly along the rail.
words.exampleZh: 把潤滑脂沿著滑軌均勻塗開。
words.notes: 各處一樣，沒有厚薄不均。

words.example: Excavation for the new pit uncovered an old coolant pipe.
words.exampleZh: 挖新地坑時挖到一支舊的冷卻液管。

words.example: The feasibility of a second shift depends on power, not on orders.
words.exampleZh: 能否開第二班取決於電力，不取決於訂單。

words.example: They will forge the hook from one piece of steel, not weld it.
words.exampleZh: 他們會用一整塊鋼鍛出掛鉤，而不是焊接。
words.notes: 鍛造金屬。另一個意思是偽造。

words.example: This forging still needs a machining pass on the bore.
words.exampleZh: 這件鍛件的內孔還要再加工一刀。
words.notes: 鍛造這個做法，或鍛出來的工件。

words.example: The former for this bottle is worn and makes a wavy neck.
words.exampleZh: 這個瓶子的成型模已經磨損，瓶頸會起波浪。
words.notes: 名詞可以指成型模具。形容詞是以前的、前任的。

words.example: A late resin delivery will hamper the trial scheduled for Monday.
words.exampleZh: 樹脂晚到會妨礙星期一的試產。
words.notes: 使進度變慢或受阻。名詞另指有蓋的籃子。

words.example: The new motor has more horsepower than the gearbox can take.
words.exampleZh: 新馬達的馬力超過變速箱承受得了的程度。

words.example: The housing design started as a sketch and a lot of imagination.
words.exampleZh: 外殼設計一開始只是一張草圖和許多想像。
words.notes: 在腦中構思新東西的能力。

words.example: An imaginative guard covers the blade without blocking the view.
words.exampleZh: 一個有想像力的護罩蓋住刀片，又不擋住視線。
words.notes: 點子新、不落俗套。imaginable 是想像得到的，是另一個字。

words.example: The line stopped making imitations and switched to its own mold.
words.exampleZh: 這條線停止做仿製品，改用自己的模具。

words.example: The developer learned the process by immersion on the night shift.
words.exampleZh: 開發人員靠夜班的沉浸式跟著做，才學會這個製程。

words.example: He stayed impassive even when the first samples all failed.
words.exampleZh: 第一批樣品全數失敗時，他仍然面無表情。

words.example: Clean water is a critical ingredient in this plating bath.
words.exampleZh: 乾淨的水是這個電鍍槽的關鍵成分。
words.notes: 構成整體的材料或要素。

words.example: The director said the team was lacking in initiative on the leak.
words.exampleZh: 主任說小組對漏液不夠主動。
words.notes: 自己開始做事的意願。也可以指一項倡議。

words.example: We can innovate the fixture without changing the approved material.
words.exampleZh: 我們可以改進治具，而不改已經核准的材料。

words.example: This clamp is a small innovation, but it removes one whole step.
words.exampleZh: 這個夾具是一項小創新，卻省掉一整個步驟。

words.example: The innovator who designed the feeder now leads the pilot cell.
words.exampleZh: 設計送料機的那位創新者現在帶領試量產單元。

words.example: The handle shape was an inspiration from the way operators grip the tool.
words.exampleZh: 握把的形狀靈感來自作業員拿工具的方式。
words.notes: 突然想到的好點子，或鼓舞。

words.example: The intention is to repair the machine, not to replace it.
words.exampleZh: 打算是修好這台機器，不是換掉它。

words.example: The introduction of the foreign spindle took six weeks of trials.
words.exampleZh: 引進這支國外主軸，試了六個星期。
words.notes: 把新東西帶進來。也可以指導言或介紹。

words.example: Intuition said the noise was the bearing, and the teardown confirmed it.
words.exampleZh: 直覺認為異音來自軸承，拆開後證實了。
words.notes: 未經完整推論就有的判斷。

words.example: The inventive jig uses one lever instead of three clamps.
words.exampleZh: 這個有巧思的治具用一根槓桿取代三個夾具。
words.notes: 善於想出新裝置或辦法。

words.example: This tumbler was built for jewelry, not for industrial screws.
words.exampleZh: 這台滾磨機是為珠寶做的，不是為工業螺絲。
words.notes: 美式拼法 jewelry。英式常拼 jewellery。

words.example: The new layout puts inspection next to packing.
words.exampleZh: 新佈局把檢驗放在包裝旁邊。
words.notes: 機器、工位或版面的安排。

words.example: Toolmaking became his lifelong work after the apprenticeship.
words.exampleZh: 學徒期結束後，模具就成了他的終身工作。

words.example: We manufacture the housings here and buy the motors.
words.exampleZh: 外殼我們自己製造，馬達則外購。

words.example: Manufacturing of the valve stays in this plant.
words.exampleZh: 這個閥的製造留在這座廠。

words.example: The trial showed the alloy will melt at a lower temperature than expected.
words.exampleZh: 試驗顯示這種合金熔化的溫度比預期低。

words.example: The control module plugs in under the panel.
words.exampleZh: 控制模組插在面板下方。

words.example: The plastic mold took a year to cut and polish.
words.exampleZh: 這副塑膠模具花了一年才切削、拋光完成。
words.notes: 美式拼法 mold。也可以指黴菌。

words.example: The hinge has originality: nobody else folds it this way.
words.exampleZh: 這個鉸鏈有獨創性，沒有別人這樣折。

words.example: She was a pioneer in using laser marking on this alloy.
words.exampleZh: 她是在這種合金上用雷射打標的先驅。

words.example: Dyeing wastewater is the main pollutant from this plant.
words.exampleZh: 染整廢水是這座廠的主要污染物。

words.example: This hand press is the precursor of the automatic cell.
words.exampleZh: 這台手動沖床是自動單元的前身。

words.example: The plant is the main producer of these switches in the region.
words.exampleZh: 這座廠是區內這些開關的主要生產者。

words.example: The company will launch one new product this quarter.
words.exampleZh: 公司這一季會推出一項新產品。

words.example: The reform of the cell was productive: changeover time fell by half.
words.exampleZh: 單元的改革有成效，換線時間少了一半。

words.example: The new fixture raised productivity without adding people.
words.exampleZh: 新治具提高了生產力，沒有加人。

words.example: The dealer wants a prototype before the tooling is cut.
words.exampleZh: 經銷商希望在開模之前先看到原型。

words.example: Recycling of the aluminum offcuts pays for the extra bins.
words.exampleZh: 回收鋁邊料的收入夠付額外的回收桶。
words.notes: 把用過的材料再處理使用。

words.example: Quality will regress if we skip the second inspection.
words.exampleZh: 如果省掉第二次檢驗，品質會退步。

words.example: The two cable ends reunite inside the sealed junction.
words.exampleZh: 兩截電纜在密封接頭裡重新接上。

words.example: Take a sample from each reel before the lot is released.
words.exampleZh: 每卷放行前先抽一個樣品。

words.example: The first public demo was sensational, and orders followed.
words.exampleZh: 第一次公開示範引起轟動，訂單跟著來了。
words.notes: 引起很大注意。也可以指極好。

words.example: The cracked mold is a setback, not the end of the project.
words.exampleZh: 模具裂了是一次挫折，不是專案的結束。

words.example: The quake severely reduced orders from that region.
words.exampleZh: 地震使該地區的訂單嚴重減少。
words.notes: 程度很重。也可以指嚴格地。

words.example: The night shift finishes the parts the day shift could not.
words.exampleZh: 夜班把日班沒做完的零件做完。
words.notes: 名詞常指班次。動詞是移動、改換。

words.example: The leak stems from a scratch in the seal, not from the pump.
words.exampleZh: 滲漏源於密封件上的刮痕，不是幫浦。
words.notes: stem from 是起因於。名詞可以指莖或詞幹。

words.example: Their strategy is to qualify two suppliers for every critical part.
words.exampleZh: 他們的策略是每個關鍵零件都認證兩家供應商。

words.example: They will streamline changeover so one person can do it.
words.exampleZh: 他們會把換線精簡到一個人就能做。
words.notes: 去掉多餘步驟，使更有效率。

words.example: The maintenance lead will survey every guard before the audit.
words.exampleZh: 保養主管會在稽核前調查每一個護罩。
words.notes: 查看並記錄現況。也可以指測量。

words.example: Workers tag rejected parts in red before they leave the bench.
words.exampleZh: 工人用紅色標籤標出不良品，才讓它們離開工作臺。
words.notes: 標籤，或貼上標籤。另可指尾隨。

words.example: Threading the nut onto a damaged bolt will strip it.
words.exampleZh: 把螺帽旋上受損的螺栓會把牙磨掉。
words.notes: 名詞是線或螺紋。動詞是穿過去或旋上。

words.example: Hourly throughput rose after the second fixture arrived.
words.exampleZh: 第二套治具到了之後，每小時產出量上升。
words.notes: 一段時間內通過並完成的數量。

words.example: There is tremendous pressure to ship before the holiday shutdown.
words.exampleZh: 假期停線前出貨的壓力非常大。

words.example: The yield this week is unprecedented for this alloy.
words.exampleZh: 本週這種合金的良率是空前的。

words.example: Poor visibility in the paint booth hides runs in the coating.
words.exampleZh: 烤漆房能見度差，看不出塗層的垂流。
words.notes: 看得清不清楚。商業上也可指事情被看見的程度。

words.example: The crack is visible without a magnifier.
words.exampleZh: 這道裂痕不用放大鏡就看得見。
words.notes: 眼睛或檢查可以發現的。

words.example: A calibrated torque wrench is vital on this joint.
words.exampleZh: 這個接頭一定要用校正過的扭力扳手。
